svg.aria-label: Project 02: Production GitOps Delivery on Amazon EKS Fargate with CloudFront and Keyless CI/CD
svg.title: Project 02: Production GitOps Delivery on Amazon EKS Fargate with CloudFront and Keyless CI/CD
svg.text: Ship to production with no long-lived AWS credentials, and let the cluster
GitHub Actions federates into AWS via OIDC; trust limited to one repo and
ArgoCD auto-sync, prune and self-heal reverts configuration drift
CloudFront with private S3 origin (OAC), ALB as the API origin
IRSA with a least-privilege Bedrock policy for the backend pod
